# chainlog

> Bookmark, find and resume Claude Code and Codex sessions for QA chain testing. One command after
> /exit saves the session with a note; `chainlog next <PR>` resumes the latest round of a PR's test chain.

- [Install (for agents)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mdismail-cse/chainlog/main/INSTALL.md): step-by-step, consent first
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mdismail-cse/chainlog/main/README.md): commands and examples
- [Data formats](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mdismail-cse/chainlog/main/SCHEMA.md): spool, events, session JSON

Agent-friendly commands: `chainlog find TEXT --json`, `chainlog show REF --json`, `chainlog ls --json`,
`chainlog save --args-stdin` (note on stdin), `chainlog doctor --json`.
Exit code 2 means "ask the user first": for `save`/`show`/`next` the session is ambiguous (the JSON
lists the candidates; re-run with `--id <short>`); for `setup`/`uninstall` nothing was applied because
there was no terminal and no `--yes`. Never pass `--yes` before the user agreed.
